class.name: NNBTCooldown
class.brief_description: Prevents its child branch from running again for a duration in seconds after it finishes.
class.description: Use to rate-limit an ability or branch in real time. Once the child finishes ([constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]), this decorator returns [member cooldown_return_value] without ticking the child until [member cooldown_seconds] of tree time have elapsed. Time is measured by the owning [NNBTRoot]'s elapsed tick time, so cooldowns pause when the tree is paused or disabled and continue counting down even when other branches are active. For a tick-count cooldown instead of seconds, use [NNBTCooldownTicks].

method.name: get_remaining_cooldown
method.description: Returns the remaining cooldown time in seconds, or [code]0.0[/code] when ready.

members.member: Status returned while the cooldown is active. Defaults to [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].
Cooldown duration in seconds of tree time. Set to [code]0.0[/code] or less to disable.
